judgment: Reject neck05 as an exterior construction direction. The neck reads as exposed struts and separated guard fragments, not a recognizable covered mechanical neck.
observations: The large open gap between the head and breast exposes rods, bearings, and empty space across the main throat silhouette. The owner reference has continuous layered coverage through the curved throat into the chest.
Several short plates appear as isolated fragments around the joints; their gaps are broad enough that the assembly looks unfinished rather than intentionally articulated.

The native dip and extension illustrations make the separation more conspicuous: head and throat elements pull away from the torso, with no coherent exterior envelope maintained through the motion. These are authoring illustrations, not browser captures or clearance proof.
disposition: Do not retain as a proposed finished exterior. A future neck treatment needs a continuous shaped outer envelope with deliberate narrow seams around articulated zones; exposed internal structure alone does not satisfy the silhouette.
limits: Perspective artwork supports a qualitative visual comparison only. This review makes no claim about intersection counts, physical clearance, or owner acceptance.
